slides.title: What Happened on Nov 3
slides.body: After the close, S&P 500 futures slipped about 0.5% as early results favored Democrats. Control of Congress is not final. Votes are still being counted.

slides.title: Close vs. Evening Futures
slides.subtitle: Nov 3 moves (bar = size of move)
slides.body: Nasdaq closed +0.8%. 10-year Treasury yield: 4.91% at the close.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: JPMorgan estimated a Democratic sweep could trim the S&P 500 about 0.5% on Wednesday, mainly on AI rules. Some analysts say a narrow win is largely priced in.

slides.title: What to Watch Next
items: Nov 4: Final House and Senate calls.
